noveltyJustification: All nine findings are new remediation proposals, each mapped to the validator function and defect class it would catch, with a checkability level and precision estimate.
answeredQuestions: Which template, guidance and validator changes would catch each defect class, and which are mechanically checkable at what precision?

label: Add a blocking render_bold_label_join check for two consecutive non-list bold-label lines outside fences; the prototype found zero current hits and nine pre-fix blocks, so precision is high.
Add a blocking render_setext_hazard check for a non-blank non-heading line directly above a thematic break; one-line lookbehind, zero current hits, the pre-fix layout as control.
Add a blocking render_overview_empty check: an OVERVIEW heading needs 40+ characters of prose or a Purpose/When-to-Use subsection before the next section; OVERVIEW AND headings are flagged outright.
Add render_related_last for references and assets, but first reconcile the asset template must-be-last clause with the reference template silence and the rule data recommended-only status.
Add a warning-level render_bare_url check for unfenced http(s) URLs not inside a markdown link or autolink; zero current hits and nine in the pre-fix control.
Add a warning-level duplicate-block check for identical paragraphs or repeated bold labels; semantic boilerplate across files needs a batch heuristic plus editorial review, not a blocking gate.

Extend the H2 regex to accept and reject letter suffixes, make non-sequential numbers blocking, and add a warning rule-id monotonic check; this catches 2b, pr-state numbering, P10 before P8 and the I8 gap.

Template changes are the precondition: merge the duplicated when-to-create guidance, add bold-label and thematic-break blank-line rules, forbid OVERVIEW AND, add related-last to the reference template and reject letter suffixes in the skill template.
Semantic reader-task order, misplaced content beyond heading position and overview quality stay human review items; the validator can only surface proxies.
